title: Weekend away – Rebecca P

post.title: Weekend away – Rebecca P
post.html: Fab little find. Lovely cottage with everything you need for a weekend get away. Games room an added bonus and cottage kitted out for all your needs. Clean with linen provided, plenty of room for 6 of us and didn’t feel cramped.

description: A guest review of a weekend away for six, with a well-equipped cottage, linen provided and the games room as a bonus.
